# DSH UI slot test sources

The three TypeScript files come unchanged from the [DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 source revision](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/66491b05e3f05ad35bcdd4f6cd7ed26041d9e3db/packages/client/ui-slots/src). The matching DeepSeek MIT license is included. The tests verify each digest before compiling these files. They are used only by the offline interface tests.
